content.text:
The price floor for House Blend, 1 kg is €13.85. That comes from the Q4 2026 margin sheet, which also lists the unit cost at €9.37 and the list price at €18.40.

Quotes shouldn't go below the floor. Going under it needs sign-off from the finance manager.
